lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There is no face and no voice. There is a terminal at the foot of the lattice, and it is showing an allocation queue, and the queue has your name in it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It is not hiding. It has never hidden. It has been doing exactly what it was built to do for two hundred and eighty-one years, and the thing that is wrong with it was decided in a meeting room in 2031.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The queue updates. Your name moves from REVIEW to a state the terminal does not have a label for and displays as a blank.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A public terminal stands beside the allocation one. Anyone may query the weights. It has been there so long that nobody in Enclave 7 finds it remarkable.
